Conditions:

(i) If the second element is an odd number and the last element is an even number, the codes for these two (the second and the last elements) are to be interchanged.

(ii) If the third element is an even number and the fifth element is a symbol, the codes for these two (the third and the fifth elements) are to be interchanged.

(iii) If the fifth element is a symbol and the sixth element is also a symbol, both these elements (the fifth and the sixth elements) are to be coded as R.

**Applying Conditions:**

**(i) If the second element is an odd number and the last element is an even number, the codes for these two (the second and the last elements) are to be interchanged.**

 
• Second element: 7 (Odd number) - Yes
 
• Last element: 8 (Even number) - Yes

**(ii) If the third element is an even number and the fifth element is a symbol, the codes for these two (the third and the fifth elements) are to be interchanged.**

 
• Third element: 5 (Odd number) - No, it's not an even number.
 
• Condition (ii) is NOT met.

**(iii) If the fifth element is a symbol and the sixth element is also a symbol, both these elements (the fifth and the sixth elements) are to be coded as R.**

 
• Fifth element: & (Symbol) - Yes
 
• Sixth element: 4 (Number) - No, it's not a symbol.
 
• Condition (iii) is NOT met.
